# Turn an Airbnb transaction history into a Xero or QuickBooks journal

> Free Airbnb host earnings to journal converter: splits every reservation into rental income, cleaning fees, Airbnb host fees and cancellations, books pass-through occupancy tax as a liability, compares the rows to your payouts and downloads a balanced journal for Xero, QuickBooks Online or QuickBooks Desktop.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
